title: Special Session in CI in Agricultural Sciences and Agroforestry
summary: This MCII special session focuses on computational intelligence for agriculture, agroforestry, environmental sensing, and climate-aware farm management.

bullets.label: 2027 IEEE Symposium for Multidisciplinary Computational Intelligence Incubators (IEEE MCII)

sections.heading: Topics of Interest
paragraphs: Topics of interest include, but are not limited to:
bullets: Weed control, pesticides or fungicides application, disease identification.
Enhance carbon sequestration and improve crop management.
Crop yield prediction models and algorithms.
